title: VendPoint Returns to the Machine and Vend Error Credits — Customer Care Credit Guidance
content:
Credit guidance for the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program covering unused items returned into a machine and vends that did not dispense.

## Clauses in force

1. Coil machines (machine type coil) cannot take items back. An unused item may be returned into the machine only on a model whose return to machine setting is yes, in its original package, by the badge that vended it.
2. A return is accepted only when it is made no later than the model's return window, in calendar days, after the vend date of the original vend.
3. Count calendar days starting the day after the vend date; a return on the last day is accepted.
4. Count elapsed hours from the vend timestamp in the machine log to the time the error is reported; a report exactly at the limit is accepted.
5. An error credit up to the model's desk limit for vend error credits is granted by the desk from the machine log; a larger one waits for the next restock visit to confirm the item is still in the selection, and is not credited by the desk.
6. Each vend transaction may be returned or credited for a vend error only once.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following two clauses of this guidance are no longer in force; each has been superseded by the current basis for VendPoint return and vend error credits:

- "A returned item is credited at the return credit basis, the unit price of the original vend, for the units returned, never more than the units that vend issued."
- "A vend error is credited only when it is reported no later than the model's vend error reporting window, in hours, after the failed vend."

## Evidence

Clauses 2 and 4 are judged on the machine's own transaction records for the original vend named by its vend transaction number: the vend date for a return, the vend timestamp in the machine log for an error. Clause 6 is judged on the returns and vend error credits already on record against that same vend transaction number.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Return window | Vend date | Return date | Day count | Clause 2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 7 days | 10 June | 17 June | 7th day after the vend | Accepted (last day) |
| 7 days | 10 June | 18 June | 8th day after the vend | Not accepted |

| Hours counted under clause 4 | Vend timestamp | Report time | Elapsed hours |
|---|---|---|---|
| Limit of 24 hours | 10:00 on a given day | 10:00 the next day | Exactly 24, at the limit |
| Limit of 24 hours | 10:00 on a given day | 10:01 the next day | More than 24 |

## Basis questions

**Can a coil machine take an item back?** No; coil machines cannot take items back.

**May a different badge return the item?** No; the return is made by the badge that vended it.

**Can one vend be both returned and credited as a vend error?** No; each vend transaction may be returned or credited for a vend error only once.

superseded_clauses: A returned item is credited at return_credit_basis, the unit price of the original vend, for the units returned, never more than the units that vend issued.
A vend error is credited only when it is reported no later than vend_error_report_hours hours after the failed vend.
